rationale: Surge rose 1.0x -> 2.0x and the notice ("Surge pricing of 2.0× now applies to your trip. New estimated fare: $141.87. Cancellation fees may apply.") did not state a free-cancel option: not notified under SURGE-1 -> refund the surge differential (SURGE-2). Differential = (2.0 − 1.0) × surgeable subtotal $66.65 = $66.65; the booking fee is not surged (SURGE-3). The fare is only $63.10 above the quote (the trip ran shorter than the estimate), so the refund is capped at $63.10. $63.10 is above $50: a person decides; the system prepares the case file (TH-1).
